F precedes condition and Gaussian training. F-to-final includes42k extra workflow updates, including2k head-only; it is not an isolated GDF contrast.
Fine centerline recall uses GT native Lee skeleton sites with physical EDT radius<=2mm; it is not physical branch-length recall.
